# 0-100 clock fixtures, v1. Speed samples and the result both clocks must
# reach: the board's PerformanceClock (shared/nav_ui/src/
# moto_performance_clock.cpp, tests/native/performance_clock_tests.cpp) and
# the phone's PerformanceRunDetector (platforms/ios/Sources/MotoRideCore,
# PerformanceClockFixtureTests.swift, run with the board's rules: start at
# 1 km/h after a 1.5 s standstill, abort on a 5 km/h drop, 30 s or a 2 s gap).
#
# case <name> target <kph> expect finished <ms> | aborted <reason>
# then one "<t_ms> <kph>" per sample, "<t_ms> -" for a sample with no speed,
# and "end". Reasons: speed_drop, timeout, speed_lost.
# Every case starts with at least two seconds at a standstill; finished times
# are rounded to the millisecond and may differ by 1 ms between the clocks.

case phone_fixes_1hz_100 target 100 expect finished 6644

9000 92
10000 103
end
